title: Excess Tolerance Left on a Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit by Changed Circumstance
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit — excess tolerance**

An excess tolerance is left on the credit, read from the changed circumstance on the latest Loan Estimate on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File:

- a revised Loan Estimate for a program change or a loan amount change leaves 100.00 of excess;
- a revised Loan Estimate for any other changed circumstance leaves 50.00;
- an initial Loan Estimate, with no changed circumstance, leaves none.

The reduction is then the available balance less the costs the credit can still pay and less the excess tolerance, never below zero, rounded to the cent.

| Latest Loan Estimate | Excess tolerance |
|---|---|
| revised for a program change | 100.00 |
| revised for a loan amount change | 100.00 |
| revised for another changed circumstance, such as a rate lock or an appraised value change | 50.00 |
| initial, no changed circumstance | none |

### Worked example (hypothetical)

Available balance 1000.00, costs the credit can still pay 150.00:

| Latest Loan Estimate | Reduction |
|---|---|
| revised for a loan amount change | 1000.00 less 150.00 less 100.00: 750.00 |
| revised for a rate lock | 1000.00 less 150.00 less 50.00: 800.00 |
| initial | 850.00 |

With an available balance of 180.00 and the same costs, a program-change revision leaves a reduction of 0.00, the figure never going below zero.
